describe: The image shows a framed painted portrait of a seated woman with long dark hair, folded hands and a faint smile, set against a muted landscape of hills, water and a winding path. The painting sits inside an ornate carved gold-brown frame with a swirling pattern around the edge. Colours are olive-green and blue-grey in the background, a brown dress, soft flesh tones and a dark gold frame. Lighting is soft and even with low-to-moderate contrast. The frame must stay in place around the painting.
